notes.title: Devlog - Cards Design Part.2
notes.notes:
Hello Divers ! 🤿

Here the second part about cards design in Under Pressure. Check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2483950/view/3734104009466777347]first part[/url] before reading.

[h3]Story 🐙[/h3]

We follow the ascent of a diver to the surface. In his journey he meets allies who will help him move faster. There was a desire to maintain constant pressure on the diver. We wanted to have an ongoing action on each card. Independently of each other they tell something new, like comic strips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/c1c3db852eec5c6b3bd043bdca03680be9928302.png[/img]

[h3]Art Style 🫧[/h3]
[b]📢 [url=https://www.instagram.com/mangouuste/]Mangouste[/url] speaking![/b]

We wanted to start developing a visual identity for our games. Through the Under Pressure's character duo, it allowed us to set up an artistic workflow.

The implementation of a card template seemed necessary to me, to easily deploy a large volume of assets dynamically. Any addition or modification of assets is quickly published.

It creates a very good flow between art and game engine. Hibo developped his own Unity's worflow that complete the art one. For every update or new asset, it's very easy to him. We find a good way to iterate or easily develop new prototype for futur games.

The aesthetic is simple > basic shapes, a line work, strong shadows and flat colors. A post process template was also define at the beginning of the creation, to unify the global aesthetic and the light progression.

[previewyoutube=o9z-ce-VHVE;full][/previewyoutube]

The cards were made on Clip Studio, it brings resources like 3D poses as references to help me with camera angle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/1e47597664135cc6399586ee1304c87266062173.png[/img]
[i]Here are the main poses of the character.[/i]

About Kraken, we wanted him to be scary while respecting the cartoon style of the universe. His eye’s shading was very fun to do, it gives some expressions and some contrast.

[h3]Card Update 🤿[/h3]
After some time using the cards in the game, we had the feeling that we could add something on the card!

The number was floating and wasn't very integrate, so I do some research and this idea came up. Some "ink" details with an inner light as the card was lighting up the edges.

It will focus the eyes more on the card! We were happy to see this update on all the card in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/9f7375dd722b5475a5531a69b3ec342eec04829f.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you 🙏[/h3]

notes.title: Devlog - Cards Design Part.1
notes.notes:
Hello Divers ! 🤿

I am currently working on visuals and sounds improvements for next update! Check it on my socials!
[url=https://www.instagram.com/mangouuste/]Mangouste [/url]make all art on my games, follow her on Instagram!

[h3]Art Adaptation 🐙[/h3]

Under Pressure is a video game adaptation of Tim Fower's "Fugitive" board game.
Gameplay is based on cards. Values goes from #0 to #42 and show the escape of a Thief chased by a Detective.

We decided to adapt the game in a 1930's underwater style. With a Diver whishes to reach surface and a Kraken chasing him.
We were excited about this idea as it could be challenging enough to make, with a lot of references and easy to create an atmosphere with sounds and FXs.

Diver was the perfect character to work on our human style. We wanted a comic style that can be easy to reproduce, recognizable and have poses that we could reuse in the future.

Kraken was the perfect nemesis in this art style. It could be majestic and far bigger than Diver, to easily create a more powerful feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/e7094a89e4a930b4c81afc66fed6e22e110bad7a.png[/img]

We loved the idea to tell the story of the escape with the cards. Start card #0 as deepness, and final card #42 as Diver's boat. Between both each steps could be more and more brighter to show progression.  We also decomposed the progress with the three decks boundaries (1-14 15-28 29-41), each has it own characteristics, for example:
[list]
[*]     First Deck: Shark and a lot of void
[*]     Second Deck: Jellyfishes and fishes
[*]     Third Deck: Corals and relics
[/list]
There is no influence on gameplay, but it helps a lot to create an atmosphere within the game and also add colour into it.

[h3]In-game Card 🫧[/h3]

In game, a card is composed of several elements:
[list]
[*]     Value of card from #0 to 42
[*]     Needed boosts to play it
[*]     Illustration to symbolize progression
[*]     Glow on/off to show if playable
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/102c8579c918a7d6e41dafcea32af8852793daa3.png[/img]

We will talk more about cards design and story in next devlog. Stay tune to be notified!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44300283/c1c3db852eec5c6b3bd043bdca03680be9928302.png[/img]
